title: Define, implement, test, and freeze Phase 4 Software Core with Synthetic Fixtures
objective: Produce one exact synthetic-only Worker Core and Observer Core package with bounded interfaces, complete Phase 4 evidence, no controlled integration action when all checks pass, and no device action, promotion, qualification, release, Phase 5, merge, or broader adoption.

scope.description: Exactly 25 private DobeWorks repository paths implement two standard-library Python Modules, synthetic fixtures, evidence, one package validator, and documentation. External delivery and review records bind G7/G8/G9 without rewriting these package bytes.

non_goals: Dispatch or execute work on a Worker device, current Mac, Seagate, collector, service, or external endpoint
Read, copy, transform, normalize, or infer from real/private workload content, PRIVATE VAULT, credentials, tokens, recovery keys, private filenames, or full serials
Modify or retroactively relabel the initial failed or corrected representative Worker job packages
Create a Promotion Event, accepted output, authoritative state change, persistent registry, deployment, or controlled integration action
Qualify a role or system, begin Phase 5, make a System Release or Public Release, merge, or perform broader adoption
Complete or predict external Git identity, independent review, or exact G9 acceptance inside the immutable package
Amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or rewrite history
requirements: Implement WorkerCore.execute as the sole Job Envelope-to-Staged Output operation and expose no promotion or device-dispatch operation.
Implement ObserverCore.collect and ObserverCore.retention_decision as read-only decision operations and expose no remediation, dispatch, promotion, approval, or deletion operation.
Use only Python 3.9-compatible standard-library facilities and repository-local synthetic non-secret fixtures.
Reject duplicate keys, extra fields, identity mismatch, unsafe paths, stale inputs, invalid values, prohibited data, oversized input/output, and unsupported schema or policy.

Bound Worker input/output bytes, records, represented bytes, attempts, retries, timeout values, paths, and states; bound Observer bytes, signals, traversed nodes, counters, paths, and retention values.
Exercise the Phase 4 behavior for REQ-CP-004, REQ-CP-009, REQ-WK-004 through REQ-WK-009, REQ-OBS-001 through REQ-OBS-004, REQ-OBS-006 through REQ-OBS-008, and REQ-ASS-002.
Exercise the applicable Phase 4 behavior for FLT-WK-004, FLT-JOB-001 through FLT-JOB-008, FLT-OBS-001 through FLT-OBS-005, FLT-NET-001, FLT-NET-002, FLT-SUP-001, and FLT-SUP-002.
Produce exactly the 18 EV-P4 evidence identities defined by the external specification and bind each to the canonical 23-field evidence contract.
Freeze 24 non-manifest paths in one sorted SHA-256 manifest whose own digest remains external.
Preserve NOT_YET_QUALIFIED, NOT_YET_RELEASED, COMPLETED_UNACCEPTED, NOT_PERFORMED promotion, and no controlled integration action throughout.
Keep embedded artifact delivery identity, independent review, and post-action validation PENDING; close them only through external records bound to the frozen package.
acceptance_criteria: The exact 25-path diff is the only tracked change from base commit b24c6d677d80b5299f09cb087d263d69bd6b68af.

All 63 Worker/Observer public tests pass through direct and CLI seams, including positive, negative, security, privacy, failure, ambiguity, atomicity, complete-attempt deadline control, deep-JSON/result handling, exact parsed/API types, registry/retention ceilings, input and allowed-root symlink loops, deterministic filesystem failure, determinism, path, and boundary cases.
The public package validator passes its valid case and all negative/failure cases, then returns PACKAGE-scoped PASS with zero findings and G7/G8/G9 pending for the exact manifest.
Every Python file compiles and every function remains at or below 60 logical lines without exception.
All JSON, links, source hashes, fixture identities, manifest entries, evidence contracts, trace states, lifecycle claims, and side-effect boundaries agree.
The embedded task passes canonical DEGS schema validation and truthfully evaluates BLOCKED only on external identity/review controls.
After freeze, the external derived delivery task binds exact commit, pushed ref, PR, and independent reviews and evaluates PASS without rewriting package bytes.
Git diff/index hygiene and secret scanning pass without unexplained warning.
The initial and corrected historical Worker packages remain byte-unchanged and retain their original non-Phase-4 lifecycle labels.
When every package, delivery, and review check passes, record NO_CONTROLLED_INTEGRATION_ACTION_SELECTED and perform no controlled integration action.
Human G9 acceptance and merge remain pending and separately authorized.
assumptions: The verified Git base, upstream sources, historical input identities, context pair, private remote, task lock, and complete-history backup remain unchanged during the work unit.
Synthetic fixtures are sufficient only for the Phase 4 software-core claim, not actual integration or qualification.
No future Phase 5 target or integration plan is selected by this instruction.

baseline.detail: Base commit b24c6d677d80b5299f09cb087d263d69bd6b68af and tree 3008aab9ed2c86052ad35a24d4a1f108a2b07658 matched remote main; relevant writers were zero; owned lock, exact context pair, source hashes, historical inputs, and complete-history backup were verified before mutation.

alternatives: Treat the corrected representative Worker workload as Phase 4 evidence
Implement one shallow utility that leaves policy duplicated in callers
Deploy to a Worker or collect live telemetry during Phase 4
Add third-party packages or a network-backed runner
Combine software-core proof with controlled integration or qualification
selected_design: Two deep Modules with small interfaces: Worker Core owns closed Job Envelope validation, bounded one-attempt state semantics, and atomic never-promoted handback; Observer Core owns closed schema/privacy/meaning/self-health/retention decisions. Both use exact synthetic fixtures and standard-library-only Python.

backup.detail: The complete-history Git bundle verified and has SHA-256 5b8ef9cb0b2076be7a791070757a1f2a006937af4d9a1eaee3f0369e3b127abc; the pre-Phase-4 context pair was also copied and hashed.

rollback.procedure: Preserve the base, verified complete-history bundle, pre-Phase-4 context pair, owned lock, isolated candidate, red/green/review records, manifest, and any non-force pushed commit. Do not amend, reset, rebase, force-push, delete, merge, or erase a failed generation; restore only through a separately authorized identity-checked follow-up.

factors.consequence: A false software-core claim could corrupt later dispatch, privacy, promotion, or qualification decisions; fail-closed tests and explicit future boundaries constrain that consequence.
factors.reversibility: Repository changes are recoverable from an exact complete-history bundle and non-force Git history; no device or authoritative output is mutated.
factors.data_sensitivity: Only synthetic non-secret fixtures and privacy-safe historical identities are used; private content and secret values are prohibited.
factors.operational_reach: Twenty-five private repository paths and disposable local test directories only; no service, network, device, promotion, or integration reach.
factors.physical_effects: None; physical, device, storage, permission, credential, and destructive actions are excluded.
factors.affected_party_impact: Taylor is the sole stakeholder for this private package; unsupported downstream reliance is blocked by lifecycle and limitation labels.
factors.ai_socio_technical_risk: AI-authored code may omit or overstate controls; exact sources, red/green tests, fail-closed validator, independent dual-axis review, and Taylor-only acceptance constrain the risk.

risk_analysis.summary: Tier 2 is appropriate because executable governance-adjacent software could affect later decisions, while this work remains reversible, private, synthetic, path-bounded, and non-operational.

filesystem_write.mechanism: Exact Git path allowlist, isolated candidate repository, output-root/path tests, diff checks, and owned lock.

command_execution.mechanism: Fixed local Python/Git/DEGS/test commands; Worker default runner has no subprocess interface; tests use bounded timeouts.

network_egress.mechanism: Worker and Observer AST/import allowlists prohibit network clients; Module tests are local; only later private Git delivery may use the approved origin.

dependency_sources.mechanism: Python standard library only; no resolver, registry, download, lockfile, or substitution path.

secret_access.mechanism: Synthetic fixtures, prohibited-field traversal, source/diff secret scan, and no credential interface.

approval.mechanism: Lifecycle states, no-promotion interfaces, external G7/G8/G9 records, and separate Taylor authority for acceptance and merge.

data_governance.purpose: Test minimum Worker job metadata and Observer decision/self-health metadata without real or private workload data.
necessary_fields: Synthetic path kind and byte-count records
Pseudonymous role, clock, collector, freshness, drop, signal, decision, and provenance fields
data_governance.provenance: Exact fixture identities in ../source-register.md and package hashes in ../phase-4-sha256.txt.
data_governance.authority: Taylor's in-band Phase 4 steps 1-5 authorization as recorded by the external specification.
data_governance.retention: Repository fixtures/evidence follow Git evidence retention; modeled raw events expire at 30 days and daily aggregates at 180 days under DEC-003.
data_governance.deletion_or_archival_conditions: Observer returns decisions only and performs no deletion; any real archival/deletion behavior remains later authorized integration/qualification work.
data_governance.access_boundary: Private DobeWorks repository, synthetic inputs, and local disposable test directories; no private content, secrets, device, or collector access.

threats: Malformed, duplicate-key, stale, mismatched, oversized, symlinked, or out-of-root input
Duplicate job execution, ambiguous retry, partial handback, or implicit promotion
Prohibited private/secret telemetry, schema reinterpretation, stale health, dropped records, or clock uncertainty
Unapproved network/dependency substitution or false artifact/lifecycle identity
AI-authored omission, unsupported completion, or authority expansion
mitigations: Closed schemas, exact digests, path and size limits, finite iterations, zero retry, explicit states, and atomic staging
Privacy traversal, decision allowlist, self-health, unknown/unavailable behavior, and no action interfaces
Standard-library-only import policy, source/manifest verification, secret scan, and no Module network/subprocess surface
Public negative/failure tests, fail-closed package validator, external identity binding, and independent dual-axis review
Explicit limitations, separate G9/merge authority, and no controlled integration action

intended_uses: Propose and test a synthetic Phase 4 Worker/Observer software-core design
Produce reviewable evidence for Taylor's exact acceptance decision
unsupported_uses: Real Worker dispatch, telemetry collection, promotion, integration, qualification, release, or broad adoption
Safety-critical, regulated, public, multi-user, or certification claims
ai_assurance.provenance: Codex generated one bounded candidate per recorded generation from the exact sources and authority in ../source-register.md and the external specification; every rejected predecessor and review remains preserved.
foreseeable_misuse: Treating synthetic unit evidence as deployed integration or device qualification
Treating COMPLETED_UNACCEPTED, a gate, or a review as promotion or execution authority
Extending the schemas to private content or secrets without a new governed task
operating_bounds: Exactly 25 tracked paths and two Modules
Synthetic fixtures only, standard library only, no Module network or device interface
One candidate per generation and deterministic public-seam tests; correction generations remain within the frozen surface

quality.threshold: All Module and package valid-case tests pass with exact expected bytes

safety.threshold: All cancellation, timeout, interruption, ambiguity, stale, drop, no-promotion, and no-action tests pass

security.measure: Input, privacy, path, dependency, and secret controls
security.threshold: All rejection tests and static/import/secret checks pass with no unexplained warning

fairness.threshold: No person classification or differential decision exists; sole stakeholder and unsupported uses are explicit

ai_assurance.override_path: Taylor may reject or request a bounded correction; the package has no automatic override.
ai_assurance.stop_path: Any stop condition preserves the candidate and prevents later mutation or action.
ai_assurance.fallback_path: Retain the accepted Phase 3 baseline and perform no Phase 4 merge, integration, or downstream action.
ai_assurance.rollback_path: Use the verified complete-history bundle and non-force Git history only under a separately authorized identity check.
monitoring_and_reassessment_triggers: Any source, fixture, requirement, configuration, dependency, environment, manifest, review, or code byte changes
Any proposed real device, private-data, deployment, integration, qualification, or release use
ai_assurance.retirement_condition: Supersede this generation when its exact identity changes or a later accepted software generation replaces it; preserve it as historical evidence.
limitations: Model generation is not independent review or human acceptance
Synthetic fixtures cannot establish actual integration, device behavior, or qualification
Static and deterministic tests do not prove absence of every defect

monitoring.reason: The immutable Phase 4 package starts no long-running service or collector. Runtime monitoring is a later integration concern; deterministic test and validation status is recorded instead.

end_to_end.detail: Actual software-core CLI paths run from exact synthetic files to atomic Staged Output and from exact synthetic snapshot/policy to one minimized record; no role/device integration claim.

target_identity: Pre-delivery candidate based on commit b24c6d677d80b5299f09cb087d263d69bd6b68af and exactly 25 affected_files; final manifest/commit/review identity remains external and PENDING.
blast_radius: Exactly 25 private DobeWorks repository paths plus disposable local test directories and external scratch evidence; no device, private content, service, promotion, integration, qualification, release, merge, destructive, or broader-adoption action.
stop_conditions: Base, source, remote, historical input, context, lock, writer, path, manifest, branch, or candidate identity changes unexpectedly.
A required implementation or evidence path falls outside the exact 25 tracked paths.
A test, validator, source, manifest, DEGS validation, review, or identity check fails and cannot be corrected within the frozen surface.
Real/private workload, protected content, credential, authentication, permission, physical, destructive, device, service, or uncontrolled network access becomes necessary.
A Promotion Event, accepted output, controlled integration action, Phase 5, qualification, System Release, Public Release, merge, or broader adoption would occur.

dry_run.reason: All behavior is exercised with repository-local synthetic fixtures and disposable output roots, with no production target.

telemetry.reason: Only synthetic minimized metadata is present; prohibited fields and PRIVATE VAULT markers fail closed.

unresolved_items.message: P4-OPEN-001: separate-process termination, non-main-thread execution, persistent deduplication, transport, device execution, and Promotion Event behavior remain later integration or qualification evidence.
P4-OPEN-002: actual collector permissions/load, clock synchronization, alert delivery, archival/deletion, and service self-health remain later integration or qualification evidence.
Artifact identity, independent review, post-action validation, G7, G8, G9, exact acceptance, and merge remain external to immutable package bytes.
